descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
FLIGHT puts you in the captain's seat of a private jet over a whole island.

THE PRIVATE JET
An ultra-long-range jet with a glass cockpit: live flight displays, a moving map and an autopilot. Fly it with the side-stick and the thrust levers in your hands, or with the thumbsticks. Then stand up and walk back through the cabin - the galley under its skylight, the club seats, the dining table, the lounge and the stateroom - while the island goes by outside the windows.

A WHOLE ISLAND
Forty kilometres of coast, city, farmland, forest and mountains. Seven airports to land at: an international hub with two long runways, a city airport on its own island beside the downtown towers, an alpine strip in a high mountain basin, a fjord strip between rock walls, a clifftop field, a farmland airfield and a short strip on an offshore island.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
The private jet, a twin-engine supersonic fighter, a four-seat light plane and a helicopter. Each has its own cockpit and its own way of flying.

YOUR OWN HANGAR
Walk around your aircraft, repaint them and power wash them clean, then choose one and fly.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Landing challenges, a ring course up a mountain gorge, a harbour run between the bridge pylons, a night landing and an island tour - or just fly, by day, at sunset or at night.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Join up on a friend's wing or ride in their aircraft. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
